contamination_risks: SPY remains feature-only contaminated training input and is never a target return.
All ten replacement target ETF/date pairs are globally untouched at freeze.
The failed v1 checkpoints and target identities contribute no strategy metrics or promotion evidence.
The complete 48-trial grid and all evidence dates remain unchanged.
All of 2020 remains embargo and 2021 replacement target outcomes are untouched.
family_contract.entry_rule: After the completed close, subtract the matching SPY return from each frozen target ETF return, standardize against the preceding sixty observations, require the frozen downside z threshold and SPY trend gate, then enter the most negative eligible residual at the next open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve the frozen stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after two or five sessions.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within five sessions.
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This pre-metric structural successor replaces every v1 target identity after SPLG's frozen history proved incomplete. It changes no mechanism, parameter, date, cost, selection, execution, or evidence gate.
family_contract.mechanism: Buy the largest one- or three-session ETF downside residual versus SPY after a standardized overshoot.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: The complete fixed ETF denominator and SPY history must be fresh.
Overnight positions require confirmed GTC protection.
Missing, halted, or structurally unprotectable targets are missed.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Most negative completed residual z-score, then lexical symbol; at most one new family entry per session.
family_contract.selection_rule: Portfolio risk, concurrent-position, aggregate-risk, daily-entry, gross-notional, and capital-contention caps remain authoritative.
family_contract.stop_rule: Freeze a stop one or one-and-a-half completed ATR14 below entry; invalid stops, missing bars, and split-affected windows are missed.

universe_requirements.selection_basis: Ten long-history liquid equity, factor, international, and industry ETFs replacing every target identity whose data was accessed by the structurally incomplete v1.
